wholePhysicalScope: Named machine shop way 345809282 matches the Old Mill Park address. Surveyed radii follow the local footprint, native mill dam line 1322314936, mapped modern overlook and unaltered USGS local elevations. The extant ruined walls are interpreted from two Qualla photos.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the brick Machine Shop, low factory ruins with iron turbine and the river dam. Near levels add masonry courses and metal detail.
limitations: The machine shop eaves, openings and inaccessible wall details are approximate. The ruin row, turbine fittings and masonry course widths are inferred from ground-level photographs and measured site positions.
The mill dam is represented as a solid masonry form. Moving water, woodland, the modern covered bridge, the private redeveloped 1882 mill and the entire vanished factory are outside this model.
